methods.name: public boolean contains(@Event int event)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the given {@link Event} occurred.
     *
     * @param event The {@link Event}.
     * @return Whether the {@link Event} occurred.

methods.name: public boolean containsAny(@Event int... events)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether any of the given {@link Event events} occurred.
     *
     * @param events The {@link Event events}.
     * @return Whether any of the {@link Event events} occurred.

methods.name: public int size()

Although index-based access is possible, it doesn't imply a particular order of these * events. * * @param index The index.
